description:
Amendment 1: Amended site visit date from "Monday 01 December" to "Tuesday 01 December". Site visit meeting spot will be Bldg 304 on Offutt AFB. Due date and time of EAL is confirmed at 04:00 PM CST on Tuesday, 24 November 2026. 

  

 Amendement 2: Attached pre site visit Questions and Answers docuement to solicitation as "Attachment 4 - Questions and Answers - 11.23.2026" and updated EAL to most recent version. 

 ________________________________________________________________________________________________________ 

  SOLICITATION  

  FA460026Q0009  

  B304 FAN DRIVE REPLACEMENT  

  Offutt AFB, NE  

 This is a solicitation for commercial SERVICES in accordance with the format in Revolutionary Federal Acquisition Regulation Overhaul (RFO) Subpart 12.202(b)(1), as supplemented with additional information included in the notice. This announcement constitutes the only solicitation; quotes are being requested, and a separate solicitation will not be issued. 

 Solicitation number FA4600-27-Q-0009 is issued as a Request for Quotation (RFQ) for The Contractor shall procure and provide a new fan drive to match the cooling tower #3 fan and motor. The new motor is being provided and installed on a separate contract. The fan drive shall be like-for-like in terms of fit, form, and function; it shall be compatible with the existing cooling tower fan and existing/new motor configuration and match the current unit capacity, size, and operational requirements. 

 This acquisition is/is not set aside for a small business concern under NAICS 561210, NAICS Facility Support Services. This solicitation incorporates provisions and clauses by reference. The full text of provisions and clauses may be accessed electronically at www.acquisition.gov. All prospective offerors must be registered in the System for Award Management (SAM) at www.sam.gov. Lack of a SAM registration will make an offeror ineligible for award. 

  APPLICABLE LABOR LAWS  

 This solicitation is subject to the Service Contract Labor Standards RFO 52.222-41 and the current wage determination, Service Contract Act WD #2015-5005, Revision 30, Revised on 26 August 2026. The most updated wage determination can be found at https://sam.gov/wage-determinations. 

  SITE VISIT   

 A site visit will take place on Tuesday 01 December 2026, 01:00 PM CST at Bldg 304. The attached EAL form will need completed and returned by 04:00 PM CST, 24 November 2026. Base access is not guaranteed. 

  QUESTIONS DUE DATE AND TIME  

 All questions concerning this solicitation shall be sent in writing to the Contracting Office by 07 December 2026, 10:00 AM CST. Answers to all questions will be posted via amendment to www.sam.gov as soon as readily available. 

  OFFER DUE DATE AND TIME  

 All offers must be submitted to the Contracting Office by 14 December 2026, 10:00 AM CST. 

  CONTRACTING OFFICE CONTACT INFORMATION  

 All information regarding this solicitation shall be sent by email to: 

 Contract Specialist – SSgt Joshua Peters, joshua.peters.17@us.af.mil 

 Contracting Officer – Mr. Casey Hupton, casey.hupton.1@us.af.mil
